resources.name: Penthouse
resources.desc: by Jonas Ohlsson generates critical-path CSS

resources.name: Critical
resources.desc: by Addy Osmani generates & inlines critical-path CSS (uses Penthouse, Oust and inline-styles)

resources.name: CriticalCSS
resources.desc: by FilamentGroup finds & outputs critical CSS

resources.name: mod_pagespeed
resources.desc: Apache module for automatic PageSpeed optimization

resources.name: ngx_pagespeed
resources.desc: Nginx module for automatic PageSpeed optimization

resources.name: critical-css-casperjs
resources.desc: CasperJS script to pull critical CSS information from pages

resources.name: dr-css-inliner
resources.desc: PhantomJS script to inline above-the-fold CSS on a page.

resources.name: inline-styles
resources.desc: by Max Ogden, replaces <link> tags with inline <style> tags + inlines CSS url() calls with data URIs

resources.name: gulp-inline-source
resources.desc: by Filip Malinowski, replaces <link> tags with inline <style> tags, and replaces <script src=""> tags with their inline content

resources.name: inline-critical
resources.desc: by Ben Zörb, inline critical path CSS and load existing stylesheets with loadCSS

resources.name: loadCSS
resources.desc: loads CSS asynchronously using JS. Research that led to this is also available.

resources.name: async & conditional loading
resources.desc: POC script for loading CSS files asynchronously and conditionally based on body tag classes

resources.name: basket.js
resources.desc: async script/resource loader with support for localStorage caching. Can be extended to load stylesheets.

resources.name: PageSpeed Insights
resources.desc: Online tool that measures the performance of a page for mobile devices and desktop devices. It fetches the url twice, once with a mobile user-agent, and once with a desktop-user agent.

resources.name: PSI
resources.desc: Node module for PageSpeed Insights reporting as part of your build process. Use directly with Gulp or use grunt-pagespeed if a Grunt user. For local testing, a write-up using this task and ngrok is available.

resources.name: PageSpeed Insights DevTools extension
resources.desc: Chrome extension for running PageSpeed tests from inside the browser.

resources.name: PageSpeed Insights Checker for mobile extension
resources.desc: checks Mobile PageSpeed score for every page and gives you a handy preview.
